arxiv-2101-02289.title: Hyperboost: Hyperparameter Optimization by Gradient Boosting surrogate models.
arxiv-2101-02289.creator: Jeroen van Hoof, Joaquin Vanschoren
arxiv-2101-02289.description: Abstract Bayesian Optimization is a popular tool for tuning algorithms in automatic machine learning (AutoML) systems. Current state-of-the-art methods leverage Random Forests or Gaussian processes to build a surrogate model that predicts algorithm performance given a certain set of hyperparameter settings.

arxiv-2207-06486.title: Distributions of Hook Lengths Divisible by Two or Three
arxiv-2207-06486.creator: Hannah Lang, Hamilton Wan, Nancy Xu
arxiv-2207-06486.description: Abstract . For fixed t = 2 t=2 or 3 3 , we investigate the statistical properties of { Y ^ t ​ ( n ) } \{\hat{Y}_{t}(n)\} , the sequence of random variables corresponding to the number of hook lengths divisible by t t among the partitions of n n .

arxiv-2209-00903.title: Barrow holographic dark energy in the Brans-Dicke cosmology
arxiv-2209-00903.creator: S. Ghaffari, G. G. Luciano, S. Capozziello
arxiv-2209-00903.description: Abstract We construct a holographic model for dark energy in the Brans-Dicke cosmology by using the holographic principle considering the Barrow entropy instead of the standard Bekenstein-Hawking one. The former arises from the effort to account for quantum-gravitational effects in black-hole physics and, according to the gravity-thermodynamic conjecture, in the cosmological framework.

arxiv-2212-10968.title: Strategic multi-task coordination over regular networks of robots with limited computation and communication capabilities
arxiv-2212-10968.creator: Yi Wei, Marcos M. Vasconcelos
arxiv-2212-10968.description: Abstract Coordination is a desirable feature in multi-agent systems, allowing the execution of tasks that would be impossible by individual agents. We study coordination by a team of strategic agents choosing to undertake one of the multiple tasks. We adopt a stochastic framework where the agents decide between two distinct tasks whose difficulty is randomly distributed and partially observed.

arxiv-2302-09793.title: Scaling laws of the out-of-time-order correlators at the transition to the spontaneous 𝒫𝒯 \cal{PT} -symmetry breaking in a Floquet system
arxiv-2302-09793.creator: Wen-Lei Zhao, Ru-Ru Wang, Han Ke, Jie Liu
arxiv-2302-09793.description: Abstract We investigate both numerically and analytically the dynamics of out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) in a non-Hermitian kicked rotor model, addressing the scaling laws of the time dependence of OTOCs at the transition to the spontaneous 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} symmetry breaking.

arxiv-2406-17731.title: Global solutions to semilinear parabolic equations driven by mixed local-nonlocal operators
arxiv-2406-17731.creator: Stefano Biagi, Fabio Punzo, Eugenio Vecchi
arxiv-2406-17731.description: Abstract . We are concerned with the Cauchy problem for the semilinear parabolic equation driven by the mixed local-nonlocal operator ℒ = − Δ + ( − Δ ) s \mathcal{L}=-\Delta+(-\Delta)^{s} , with a power-like source term. We show that the so-called Fujita phenomenon holds, and the critical value is exactly the same as for the fractional Laplacian.

arxiv-2502-11747.title: Open-Ended and Knowledge-Intensive Video Question Answering
arxiv-2502-11747.creator: Md Zarif Ul Alam, Hamed Zamani
arxiv-2502-11747.description: Abstract . Video question answering that requires external knowledge beyond the visual content remains a significant challenge in AI systems. While models can effectively answer questions based on direct visual observations, they often falter when faced with questions requiring broader contextual knowledge.

arxiv-2503-10635.title: A Frustratingly Simple Yet Highly Effective Attack Baseline: Over 90% Success Rate Against the Strong Black-box Models of GPT-4.5/4o/o1
arxiv-2503-10635.creator: Zhaoyi Li, Xiaohan Zhao, Dong-Dong Wu, Jiacheng Cui, Zhiqiang ShenVILA Lab, MBZUAI
arxiv-2503-10635.description: Abstract Despite promising performance on open-source large vision-language models (LVLMs), transfer-based targeted attacks often fail against black-box commercial LVLMs. Analyzing failed adversarial perturbations reveals that the learned perturbations typically originate from a uniform distribution and lack clear semantic details, resulting in unintended responses.

arxiv-2507-12057.title: Spectral synthesis of 3D unified model atmospheres with winds for O stars
arxiv-2507-12057.creator: L. Delbroek, J.O. Sundqvist, D. Debnath, N. Moens, F. Backs, C. Van der Sijpt, O Verhamme, P. Schillemans
arxiv-2507-12057.description: Abstract Context. Spectroscopic studies of massive and luminous O-type stellar atmospheres and winds have primarily been done by using one-dimensional (1D), spherically symmetric and stationary models. However, both observations and modern theoretical models show that such O stars have highly structured and variable atmospheres and winds. Aims.

arxiv-2508-10706.title: Hasse norm principle for extensions of prime squared degree
arxiv-2508-10706.creator: Yasuhiro Oki
arxiv-2508-10706.description: Abstract . We give an equivalent condition for the validity of the Hasse norm principle for finite separable extensions of prime squared degree of global fields. Our theorem recovers the result of Drakokhrust–Platonov, which claims that the Hasse norm principle holds for adequate extensions of prime squared degree. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 11E72; Secondary 20C10 1.

arxiv-2512-02418.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Bridge On-chain and Off-chain Transparency in Stablecoins
arxiv-2512-02418.creator: Yuexin Xiang, Yuchen Lei, SM Mahir Shazeed Rish, Yuanzhe Zhang, Qin Wang, Tsz Hon Yuen, Jiangshan Yu, [1.5ex]
arxiv-2512-02418.description: Abstract Stablecoins such as USDT and USDC aspire to peg stability by coupling issuance controls with reserve attestations. In practice, however, the transparency is split across two worlds: verifiable on-chain traces and off-chain disclosures locked in unstructured text that are unconnected.

arxiv-2603-03801.title: Variational Gibbs State Preparation on Trapped-Ion Devices
arxiv-2603-03801.creator: Reece Robertson, Mirko Consiglio, Josey Stevens, Emery Doucet, Tony J. G. Apollaro, Sebastian Deffner

arxiv-2606-20331.creator: Robert Ganian, Mathis Rocton

govdocs-archive_org-las-tv-20250904-1311.creator: Unknown
govdocs-archive_org-las-tv-20250904-1311.description: Collection of translated Soviet documents, including an August 8, 1978 letter from the USSR Academy of Sciences and an information list on anomalous atmospheric and space phenomena sent to military unit commanders; the compiler is not identified.

hakluyt-principal-navigations-maclehose-.title: The Principal Navigations, Voyages, Traffiques and Discoveries of the English Nation, Vol. 9
hakluyt-principal-navigations-maclehose-.creator: Richard Hakluyt
hakluyt-principal-navigations-maclehose-.description: Hakluyt's Principal Navigations (1598-1600) - the great English voyage collection that made travel literature a national epic; the source-book for every Elizabethan voyage narrative. The 12-volume MacLehose reprint (Glasgow, 1903-05), the standard complete edition. Vol. 9 of 12.

pmc-10595318.title: eHealth profile of patients with diabetes
pmc-10595318.creator: M Jendly, V Santschi, S Tancredi, I Konzelmann, L Raboud, Arnaud Chiolero
pmc-10595318.description: BackgroundDigital health technology can be useful to improve the health of patients with diabetes, to support patient-centered care, and self-management. In this cross-sectional study, we described the eHealth profile of patients with diabetes, based on their use of digital health technology, and its association with sociodemographic characteristics.

pmc-10722897.title: Real-time emotion generation in human-robot dialogue using large language models
pmc-10722897.creator: Chinmaya Mishra, Rinus Verdonschot, Peter Hagoort, Gabriel Skantze
pmc-10722897.description: Affective behaviors enable social robots to not only establish better connections with humans but also serve as a tool for the robots to express their internal states. It has been well established that emotions are important to signal understanding in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI).

pmc-11529886.title: Drosophila require both green and UV wavelengths for sun orientation but lack a time-compensated sun compass
pmc-11529886.creator: Haneal Pae, Jingzhu Liao, Nicole Yuen, Ysabel Milton Giraldo
pmc-11529886.description: Celestial orientation and navigation are performed by many organisms in contexts as diverse as migration, nest finding and straight-line orientation. The vinegar fly, Drosophila melanogaster, performs menotaxis in response to celestial cues during tethered flight and can disperse more than 10 km under field conditions.

pmc-11593270.title: Screening of the Nutritional Properties, Bioactive Components, and Antioxidant Properties in Legumes
pmc-11593270.creator: Mihaela Multescu, Alina Culetu, Iulia Elena Susman, Francisca Hernández Garcia
pmc-11593270.description: This study provides an assessment of nutrients (protein, amino acid profiles, fiber, starch), phenolic content TPC, flavonoid content TFC, and antioxidant capacity through different in vitro methods in 12 legume species (red, green, yellow, brown, and black lentils; mung, pinto, black, and kidney beans; chickpea, soy, and lupin) and hemp.

pmc-11691765.title: ASSESSING THE IMPACT OF THE WYOMING DEMENTIA TOGETHER CAREGIVER NETWORK ON RURAL CAREGIVERS
pmc-11691765.creator: Barbara Dabrowski, Christine McKibbin, Catherine Carrico, Sabine Schenck, Stacy Carling, Abby Teply, Elizabeth Punke, Katherine Kitchen Andren
pmc-11691765.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Approximately 15.7 million people care for a family member or friend living with dementia (CDC, 2023). Many programs have been developed to support and educate dementia caregivers, but fewer are designed to reach rural areas. The Wyoming Dementia Together (WDT) Caregiver Network is an adaptation of the Extension for Community Health Outcomes (ECHO) model, created to enhance capacity for care in rural areas.

pmc-12434314.title: Feeling Disconnected: River Fragmentation Alters Parenting, Aggression, and Risk‐Taking in Threespine Stickleback
pmc-12434314.creator: F. Leri, L. R. Stein
pmc-12434314.description: Habitat fragmentation is a global challenge stemming from human‐induced change. As habitat fragmentation is expected to worsen over time, there is a need to identify organism traits that can predict population persistence within fragments. Behavioral traits are primary candidates for understanding population response to fragmentation because behavior often serves as a first response to changing conditions.

pmc-12456084.title: Artificial intelligence in proliferative diabetic retinopathy: advancing diagnosis, precision surgery, and anti-VEGF therapy optimization
pmc-12456084.creator: Geng-Qian Ke, Yang-Jun Fu, Zhuo-Han Huang, Shi-Xue Dai, Yun-Hua Wen, Hai-Xiang Lv
pmc-12456084.description: Proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) represents the most advanced and vision-threatening stage of diabetic retinopathy (DR) and remains a leading cause of blindness in individuals with diabetes. This review presents a comprehensive overview of recent advances in the application of artificial intelligence (AI) for the diagnosis and treatment of PDR, emphasizing its clinical potential and associated challenges.

pmc-12768611.title: OP19 Clinical Effectiveness Of Glucocorticoids For The Treatment Of Knee Osteoarthritis – Systematic Review And Longitudinal Meta-Analysis
pmc-12768611.creator: Magdalena Moshi, Alvin Atlas, John Rathbone, Danielle Stringer, Thomas Vreugdenburg
pmc-12768611.description: IntroductionGlobally, knee osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent and disabling condition. Intra-articular glucocorticoid injection (IAGI) is widely used to treat knee OA. However, there is conflicting evidence on the benefit-harm profile of IAGI for this indication. This study aimed to determine the clinical effectiveness and safety of IAGI for knee OA.

pmc-13171980.title: LLM-Assessed Relatedness of Microbiome Study Descriptions Aligns more Strongly with Functional than with Taxonomic Profile Similarity
pmc-13171980.creator: Nefeli Kleopatra Venetsianou, Savvas Paragkamian, Konstantinos Kalaentzis, Alexios Loukas, Christina Damianou, Vincenzo Lagani, Lars Juhl Jensen, Evangelos Pafilis
pmc-13171980.description: Microbiome studies reveal the taxonomic and functional composition of microbial communities inhabiting many diverse environments. Comprehensive microbiome repositories, such as MGnify, organize data into studies, each consisting of multiple sequencing runs or assemblies and accompanying metadata. This structure enables integrative, large-scale, cross-study analyses, leading to broader insights across ecosystems, hosts, and experimental contexts.

pmc-13195128.title: MRI-based brain tumor prediction using convolutional neural network framework
pmc-13195128.creator: Yalla Anitha Reddy, R. S. Dubey, R. Vijay Prakash, Ausif Padder
pmc-13195128.description: Deep learning technology enables the transformation of healthcare, focusing on the deployment of lightweight or hybrid diagnostic models for insufficiently resourced medical facilities. Early-stage brain tumor diagnosis supports doctors in developing better treatment strategies and enhancing prognosis results. In this work, we present a CNN-based model for automated brain tumor identification through magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

pmc-13213109.title: Bacterial Fluorescence-Based Biosensor for Detecting Propionate in Culture Media for Diagnostic Applications
pmc-13213109.creator: Salvador Fabela, Camilo P Martínez-Reyes, Rene Arredondo-Hernandez, Gonzalo Castillo-Rojas, Patricia Orduña, Enrique O Graue-Hernández, Yolanda López-Vidal
pmc-13213109.description: BackgroundEngineering bacteria for disease diagnosis and treatment is an emerging area of medical research that involves assessing short-lived molecules in complex, dynamic environments. Detecting metabolites in situ offers significant opportunities for identifying responsive cellular populations. Among suitable targets for this technology are short-chain fatty acids, such as propionate, that play crucial roles in human health and disease.

pmc-13374336.title: First report of pleural mesothelioma treated with cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy in Kazakhstan: a case report
pmc-13374336.creator: Kalibekov Nurtas, Digay Alexandr, Zhaxybayev Bakhyt, Mukazhanov Nurlan, Shalekenov Sanzhar, Burkitbayev Zhandos, Jamilya Saparbay
pmc-13374336.description: BackgroundMalignant pleural mesothelioma (MPM) is a rare but aggressive neoplasm arising from the mesothelial lining of the pleura.Despite advancements in systemic chemotherapy and targeted therapies, the prognosis for MPM remains poor, with a median survival of 8–14 months. Standard treatment modalities include surgery in combination with radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy.

pmc-13389435.title: Single Cell RNA Sequencing Reveals THBS1+CD14+ Monocyte Modulates Inflammatory Activation via NRLP3‐Inflammasome in Congenital Heart Block
pmc-13389435.creator: Sha Lin, Jie Tang, Chuan Wang, Yimin Hua, Haiyan Yu, Kaiyu Zhou, Yifei Li
pmc-13389435.description: Isolated congenital heart block (iCHB) is defined as atrioventricular block without structural cardiac defects, characterized by irreversible fibrosis of the cardiac conduction system. Maternal autoantibodies may elicit systemic exaggerated immune responses involving type I interferon (IFN) signalling cascade, yet peripheral circulating immunity in CHB pathogenesis remains poorly understood.

pmc-13459233.title: The prognostic significance of B7-H3 expression in patients with advanced colorectal cancer
pmc-13459233.creator: Yan Huang, Ana Acuna-Villaorduna, Radhika Gali, Catarina Maia, Keerthi Cedona, Xingxing Zang, Xiaohua Qi, Wei Zhang, Chenxin Zhang, Juan Lin, Qiang Liu, Radhashree Maitra, Sanjay Goel
pmc-13459233.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBiomarkers, particularly prognostic and immune based, are lacking in colorectal cancer (CRC). This study aimed to evaluate the expression of novel immune based biomarkers among patients with CRC to predict clinical outcomes.MethodsA CRC tumor microarray (TMA) was developed from a multiracial patient population, and expression of diagnostic markers (CK7, CK20, CDX2) and immune based (HHLA2, B7-H3, PD-L1) determined by immunohistochemistry (IHC) in a novel quantitative manner. Comprehensive clinical information was extracted.
